summary: Enveric Biosciences filed a Prospectus Supplement (424B5) updating the maximum aggregate offering price of common stock that may be sold under its existing at-the-market (ATM) offering agreement with H.C. Wainwright. The filing is a routine shelf takedown supplement to comply with Form S-3 General Instruction I.B.6, reducing the remaining capacity to $2,425,000 after prior sales. No merger, acquisition, tender, restructuring, or other special situation is involved. This is an ordinary capital markets transaction and not a special situation.
